I rebuilt this site with [Quarto](https://quarto.org) so that the analyses I
write for coursework and research can be published directly, without copying
results into a page builder by hand. I write a `.qmd` file, render it, and it
shows up here.

## How posts work

Every post lives in its own folder under `posts/`, with an `index.qmd` inside.
The front matter at the top sets the title, date, and categories, and the blog
listing picks it up automatically.

## What is next

More posts as the semester goes on — mostly notes on econometrics and on the
tools I use to get from raw data to a finished write-up.
